top_5_current_affairs.title: Gaganyaan Mission: ISRO Successfully Tests Drogue Parachutes
top_5_current_affairs.summary: ISRO conducted a series of Drogue Parachute deployment tests critical for stabilizing the crew module during the re-entry phase of the Gaganyaan human spaceflight mission.
key_points: Drogue parachutes slow down and stabilize the module before main parachute deployment.
Developed jointly by DRDO's Aerial Delivery Research and Development Establishment (ADRDE) and ISRO.
Essential milestone for India's target to send a 3-member crew into a 400 km orbit.

top_5_current_affairs.title: RBI Approves Surplus Transfer to Central Government
top_5_current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India approved a significant surplus transfer to the Central Government, enhancing non-tax revenue and helping ease fiscal deficit pressures.
key_points: Surplus calculation is based on the revised Economic Capital Framework (ECF) recommended by the Bimal Jalan Committee.
Maintains the Contingency Risk Buffer (CRB) within the prescribed range of 5.5% to 6.5%.
Provides fiscal headroom for government capital expenditure and infrastructure development.

top_5_current_affairs.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) Implementation Focus
top_5_current_affairs.summary: Partner countries hold bilateral discussions to fast-track logistics and operational frameworks for the IMEC project launched during the G20 Summit.
key_points: Comprises the East Corridor (connecting India to the Arabian Gulf) and the Northern Corridor (connecting the Gulf to Europe).
Includes railway networks, ship-to-rail transit routes, electricity cables, and hydrogen pipelines.
Aims to boost trade efficiency, enhance energy security, and counter China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI).

top_5_current_affairs.title: NDMA Issues Fresh Directives for Urban Flood Resilience
top_5_current_affairs.summary: The National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) released updated guidelines encouraging cities to adopt 'Sponge City' principles to combat increasing urban flooding.
key_points: Recommends Sustainable Urban Drainage Systems (SuDS) and protection of natural wetlands.
Mandates real-time flood monitoring systems and integrated hydrological modeling.
Addresses risks linked to unplanned urbanization, concrete coverage, and climate-induced extreme rain events.

top_5_current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Directs Standardization of Healthcare Service Rates
top_5_current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court urged the Union Government to enforce standardized treatment rates under the Clinical Establishments Act to ensure affordable healthcare.
key_points: Reiterates that the Right to Health is an integral part of the Right to Life under Article 21.
Highlights disparities in charges between public and private health establishments.
Calls for uniform state-level enforcement of the Clinical Establishments (Registration and Regulation) Act.
